value: The contrast in 147 is between what a word means in its own right and a grammatical relation it expresses. The meaning “to use, to employ” is an example of content meaning; in a later stage of a word’s history, such an earlier meaning may be lost while a relational use remains. “Substantive” does not mean “noun,” and “relational word” is not imposed as a universal modern word-class label.
